limits.value: Not fixed; depends on conversation length, complexity, model, and features used.
limits.evidence: How much you can do depends on the length and complexity of your conversations, the model you choose, and the features you use, so there's no fixed message count.
Every plan has usage limits that reset on a rolling five-hour session window, and paid plans add weekly limits on top.
